column1: # Per-port signals on the source selector (#139): one row per signal, shown in row order on the port's signal line.
# Generated into C by scripts/gen_awto_sync.py (block awto_port_sigs). Add a row to show a new signal (e.g. a register bit
# found by scripts/port_watch.py): no other code changes.
# port: D1..D3 (board ports). label: <= 4 chars; shown as label+ / label- (bit) or label N/s (cnt).
# src:  in    = input monitor value of fw/awto/inputs.tsv row a; b = 1 inverts (pin low = signal)
#       cnt   = rising edges per second of inputs.tsv row a (counted by the input monitor every main-loop pass)
#       xreg  = XDATA / scaler register a (hex), mask b (hex): + when any masked bit is set
#       ddc   = DDC traffic on the port's DDC channel in the last 3 s (DDCn_EDID_IRQ, AwtoDdcLive)
#       tmds  = TMDS clock present: the port's frequency detector has a result (HDMI_FREQDET, AwtoTmdsIdleKhz)
